title: Gëm-gëm bi nekk ci ginaaw tron ​​bi
intro: Yenn ruuh yi duñu leen natt ci safara wala ci mbënd, waaye ci fitna bu yeex bi ñuy dundu ci biir këru jaay doole. Nit kooku dafa taxawoon ci wetu benn njiit bu doon wax ni boroom bi moo jiite askanam, waaye ci nëbbëtu, dafa gëmoon benn Yàlla bu Dëgg bi. Bi ñu gisee seen ngëm, tiis daal di ñëw — waaye digeb Yàlla itam daal di ñëw. Ndax mën nga xalaat kan la?
clues: Maa ngi dëkkoon ci suufu kaw buur bi gëna am doole ci sama réew, muy barab bu ñu bari mënul xalaat.
Sama jabar taxawoon na ci kanamu nit ñi, wax ni Yàlla la, waaye sama xol mingi ci Benn Boroom bu Dëgg bi.
Maa ngi doon ñaan ci sama xol, ndax dama ragaloon mbugal mi ñuy teg képp ku bañ sama jabar.
Bi ñu gisee sama ngëm, ñu jàpp ma, sonal ma, waaye sama làmmiñ musul wax benn baat buy wane ni gëmu ma.
Damaa sotti sama xol ci sama Boroom, di ñaan ab kër ca Àjjana fu sori ci bépp tooñ.
Man maay Asiya bint Muzahim — jabar Firawna mi bañoon Musa ak Harun.

identity.label: Man Kan laa?
options: Asiya bint Muzahim (Jabaru Firawna)
Hawwa (Awa), jigéen ju njëkk
Sarah, jabar ji njëkk ci Ibrahim
Hagar, yaayu Isma'il
Yaayu Maryam (jabaru Imran)

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Muñ fitna ndax baña bàyyi ngëm
Dundu ci biir jën wu mag
Tabax gaal gu rëy ngir mucc ci mbënd
ñu sànni leen ci safara gu tàng
Seede géej gu mag gi xaajaloo
trial.answer: Muñ fitna ndax baña bàyyi ngëm

location.label: Ëlëm bu am solo
options: Kër gu ñu tabaxal leen ca Aljanna .
Baton bu soppiku nekk jaan
Ark bu yor mbindéef bu nekk ñaar-ñaar
Nagu wurus bu benn xeet di jaamu
Sling bu ñuy jëfandikoo ngir daan xarekat bu mag
location.answer: Kër gu ñu tabaxal leen ca Aljanna .

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Ñu sargal ko ci dëkkuwaay ci Aljanna ci wetu ñu jub ñi
Ñu daanu ci suufu vague yi ñoom ak seen larme
Ñu lakk ko ci xal waaye Yàlla moo ko muccal
Rab wu rëy wann ko ba noppi sànni ko ci tefes gi
Nekkoon na ki gëna am xaalis ci seen jamono
outcome.answer: Ñu sargal ko ci dëkkuwaay ci Aljanna ci wetu ñu jub ñi

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
